description:
External-review filing deadline for a state + the date of the FINAL adverse determination. Returns the deadline date, the statutory window label + citation, and whether the exact state-specific window still needs verification (most states carry a conservative NAIC-model 4-month floor unless statute-confirmed, e.g. CA/NY). Free, no auth.

WHEN TO USE: Reference lookups: individual code details, verifying a provider registry entry, checking a prior Medigami response's signature, or tracking an outcome.

WHEN NOT: For composite workflows use the higher-level tool that calls these internally.

denial_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the FINAL adverse determination

name: get_appeal_deadline
